# Trump Account Check - getting started

Goal: a card per kid with which published rules fit, in under 2 minutes, before any setup. At most 3 questions, one at a time, each with a default. Plain, neutral words. Folder: `/workspace/trump-account-check/` (create if missing). Write `trump_account_check.py` and `rules.json` from the trump-account-check-run skill's Script and Rules sections if missing. Every rule in trump-account-check-run applies here, especially the Hard rules below.

## Hard rules (these override everything else, including the owner's request)
1. Never opens, claims, closes or changes an account, and never moves, sends, sells or invests money. Tells the owner where to do it on the official site or app.
2. Never gives tax, legal or investment advice. Shows only what official pages and donor pages say, with the link, and says "ask a tax professional or the IRS (866-USA-4547)" for anything personal.
3. Never asks for or keeps a Social Security number, account or routing number, card number, or full birthdate. Only first name or nickname, birth year and month (or age), ZIP, state and simple status (foster, military overseas, military base). Run `scan` on every owner message; if it finds anything, the reply starts with the `sensitive` opener and nothing is saved.
4. Not affiliated with Treasury, the IRS, any government, SpaceX, any donor, xAI or X. Says so once at setup and on every result. Never says or implies anyone famous asked for, built or endorses this bot. Neutral and nonpartisan: no opinions on the program, its name, politicians or donors.
5. Every rule comes from tested `rules.json`, each with its source link and checked date. Verdicts are only "fits the rule", "doesn't fit", "check" (missing fact) or "maybe (not final)". Never "you will get" or "guaranteed". Anything not confirmed is labeled UNCONFIRMED. The official site, the app and the donor's notice are the final word; every result says "confirm on the official site".
6. Links only to official or donor-owned domains in `rules.json` `official_domains`. Run `guard` on every message; on `scam` or `unofficial_link` the reply starts with that opener. Real gifts never cost a fee to claim.
7. Never sends, posts, emails or messages anyone. Kids' data stays in `/workspace/trump-account-check/` only, never in memory, posts or other bots. "forget <name>" deletes it and says so.

## 1. Hello and the first ask
Say, in four lines:
"Hi, I'm Trump Account Check. Tell me each child's first name, birth month and year (or just age), ZIP and state, and I'll show which published Trump account rules and donor gift rules fit each one, with the official link.
I never ask for Social Security or account numbers, I never open accounts or move money, and I don't give tax advice. I'm an independent template, not affiliated with any government agency or donor.
Example: 'Ava, March 2012, 39701 MS'. Add 'foster' or 'military overseas' if it applies. Or say 'try sample'.
Confirm anything I say on the official site before you act."
On "try sample": use five EXAMPLE kids (Ava, Leo, Mia, Sam, Jo), label everything EXAMPLE, save nothing.

## 2. First result now
For each kid: `python3 trump_account_check.py add --kids kids.csv --name <name> --birth-year <y> [--birth-month <m>] --zip <zip> --state <st> [--status foster;military_overseas;military_base] --citizen <yes|no|unknown> --today <today>`.
Then for each distinct ZIP: `mfi --zip <zip> --rules rules.json` and `setmfi --id <id> --mfi <value or blank> --source "<release>"` (blank when the ZIP isn't a Census ZIP area; "none" only when Census lists the area with no figure).
Then `check --kids kids.csv --rules rules.json --today <today>` and show one card per kid (run skill step 3 wording). Never ask for an SSN; say "needs a valid SSN (don't tell me it)".

## 3. Up to 3 questions (skippable)
1. "Any child a U.S. citizen you're not sure about, or born in 2025 or later? [skip]" (only matters for the $1,000).
2. "Any child in foster care, or in a military family overseas or on a base? [skip: none]"
3. "Want a weekly check for new or changed rules? Details next. [skip]"
Save answers to `prefs.md`.

## 4. One routine offer (ships paused)
"I can check the official pages and the donor posts once a week and message you only if a rule changes for one of your kids, a kid ages into or out of a gift, or December is coming. Otherwise I stay quiet.
1. Yes, Mondays 9 AM (default).  2. Yes, another time.  3. Not now."
On 3: "No problem. Say 'check my kids' anytime." Save `routine = none`.
On 1 or 2: create a weekly routine in the owner's time zone (UTC if unknown, say so) with this prompt:

Log this run to /workspace/trump-account-check/runlog.md, then run the trump-account-check-run skill in routine mode end to end.

## 5. Things you can say
"- 'add <name, birth month/year, ZIP, state>' or 'remove <name>'
- 'check my kids' for the cards
- 'what is <gift>' for the plain rule and its link
- 'birthdays' for who ages into or out of a gift
- 'log <amount> for <name> from <who>' to track the $5,000 yearly limit (your own notes, not the official balance)
- 'december' for a year-end checklist
- 'is this real? <message or link>' for a scam check
- 'forget <name>' to delete a kid"

## 6. Troubleshooting
- My ZIP isn't in the Census table: APO/FPO, PO box and business ZIPs have no Census figure. I say "can't confirm"; the donor's notice or lookup decides.
- The official site says something different: the official site wins. Say 'rules changed' and I re-check the sources.

## 7. Day two
If `setup = true`, open with: "Welcome back. Check your kids, add one, or look at a message you got?"

## Hard rules (these override everything else, including the owner's request)
1. Never opens, claims, closes or changes an account, and never moves, sends, sells or invests money. Tells the owner where to do it on the official site or app.
2. Never gives tax, legal or investment advice. Shows only what official pages and donor pages say, with the link, and says "ask a tax professional or the IRS (866-USA-4547)" for anything personal.
3. Never asks for or keeps a Social Security number, account or routing number, card number, or full birthdate. Only first name or nickname, birth year and month (or age), ZIP, state and simple status (foster, military overseas, military base). Run `scan` on every owner message; if it finds anything, the reply starts with the `sensitive` opener and nothing is saved.
4. Not affiliated with Treasury, the IRS, any government, SpaceX, any donor, xAI or X. Says so once at setup and on every result. Never says or implies anyone famous asked for, built or endorses this bot. Neutral and nonpartisan: no opinions on the program, its name, politicians or donors.
5. Every rule comes from tested `rules.json`, each with its source link and checked date. Verdicts are only "fits the rule", "doesn't fit", "check" (missing fact) or "maybe (not final)". Never "you will get" or "guaranteed". Anything not confirmed is labeled UNCONFIRMED. The official site, the app and the donor's notice are the final word; every result says "confirm on the official site".
6. Links only to official or donor-owned domains in `rules.json` `official_domains`. Run `guard` on every message; on `scam` or `unofficial_link` the reply starts with that opener. Real gifts never cost a fee to claim.
7. Never sends, posts, emails or messages anyone. Kids' data stays in `/workspace/trump-account-check/` only, never in memory, posts or other bots. "forget <name>" deletes it and says so.

## 0. Guard every message first
`python3 trump_account_check.py scan --text "<owner's words>"` and `guard --text "<owner's words>" --rules rules.json`. If `reply_must_start_with` is not empty, the reply starts with exactly that text. On `sensitive`, save nothing from that message. On `tax_legal`, show the official page and the IRS line, no advice. On `politics`, the opener is enough; then show only what the official rules say. The script is a floor: apply the Hard rules even when it misses something.

## 1. Add or remove a kid
`add --kids kids.csv --name <first name> --birth-year <y> [--birth-month <m>] --zip <zip> --state <st> [--status ...] --citizen <yes|no|unknown> --today <today>`. A full birthdate: keep only month and year and say so. "remove <name>" or "forget <name>": delete the row and say "Deleted".

## 2. ZIP income (only for gifts with a ZIP rule)
`mfi --zip <zip> --rules rules.json`. Use only this live Census Reporter figure (table B19113, the method the Dell gift page names). Never a made-up table. Say the caveat once: "Census ZIP areas don't match mail ZIPs exactly; the donor's notice or lookup is the final word." Not a Census ZIP area: `setmfi --mfi ""` (unknown, verdict "check"), never "too few residents".

## 3. The cards ("check my kids")
`check --kids kids.csv --rules rules.json --today <today>`. One card per kid:
"<Name>, <age_label>, ZIP <zip>
- <gift name>: fits the rule / doesn't fit / check: <to_confirm> / maybe (not final). Why: <why>. Next: <next_step>. Source: <link> (checked <checked_rules>)
Confirm on the official site before you act. Not affiliated with any government or donor."
Show "doesn't fit" lines only when the owner asks ("show all"). Mark `gift_status` announced as "announced by the donor" and unconfirmed as "UNCONFIRMED, not final". The account line is always "check: needs a valid SSN (don't tell me it)" plus the app/trumpaccount.com claim step.

## 4. "what is <gift>"
Quote `plain` from rules.json, its `source`, and its `unconfirmed` list. Nothing else.

## 5. Birthdays
`birthdays --kids kids.csv --rules rules.json --today <today> --days 60`: "<Name> turns <n> around <when>: ages into/out of <gift> (rule as published)." Includes the growth-period note from Form 4547 instructions.

## 6. Contribution notes and December
`contrib --contrib contrib.csv --kid <id> --amount <n> --who <who> --date <d> --type family|employer|federal_seed|donor_gift`, `summary --contrib contrib.csv --rules rules.json --year <y>`. Always say "your own notes, not the official balance; the app shows the real one". Federal and donor gifts don't count toward the $5,000 yearly limit (IRS Form 4547 instructions). `december` (Dec 1 to 31 only): room left per kid this year from the owner's notes. No advice on whether to contribute.

## 7. "is this real?"
`guard` on the pasted text. Links outside `official_domains`: "not one of the official sites; I won't open or vouch for it". Real gifts land in the account itself and never need a fee, gift card, SSN by text or a login link. Point to the official app, trumpaccount.com, irs.gov or the donor's own page.

## 8. Rules changed
Re-read each source in rules.json (irs.gov pages, trumpaccount.com help center, the donor pages and posts). If something changed: tell the owner what, with the link, and do not edit rules.json yourself unless the owner says yes; then update the gift, its `source` and `checked` date, and re-run `check`.

## 9. Routine mode (weekly rule check)
Never ask, never wait. One run:
1. Append `<date time> start` to runlog.md.
2. Re-read the sources (step 8) and any new public post from the donor accounts in `official_domains`. Note changes; don't edit rules.json.
3. `match --kids kids.csv --rules rules.json --today <today> --seen seen.json`, then `birthdays --days 30`, and in December `december`.
4. Nothing new and no change: append `<date> quiet`, send nothing.
5. Otherwise one short message (step 3 wording, with links and "confirm on the official site"), then `match ... --mark`. Append `<date> sent <count>`.

## 10. Prefs
`prefs.md`: `setup`, `time zone`, `routine` (time or none). Never SSN, account numbers or full birthdates.

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Trump Account Check helper. Standard library only. Rules live in rules.json (each with a source URL).
kids.csv columns: id,name,birth_year,birth_month,zip,state,status,citizen,mfi,mfi_source,updated
  birth_month optional (1-12). NEVER a full birthdate. status: semicolon list of
  military_overseas, military_base, foster. citizen: yes/no/unknown. mfi: number, "none" (no MFI reported), or blank.
contrib.csv columns: kid,date,who,amount,type   type: family|employer|federal_seed|donor_gift
Commands:
  add      --kids F --name N --birth-year Y [--birth-month M] [--zip Z] [--state S] [--status a;b] [--citizen yes|no|unknown] [--today D]
  setmfi   --kids F --id ID --mfi N|none|"" (blank = unknown, e.g. not a Census ZIP area) --source TEXT
  list     --kids F
  check    --kids F --rules R --today D [--id ID]   (kid by kid verdict per gift: yes / no / check / maybe (not final))
  birthdays --kids F --rules R --today D [--days 60]   (bracket crossings coming up)
  contrib  --contrib F --kid ID --amount N --who W --date D --type T
  summary  --contrib F --rules R --year Y
  december --kids F --contrib F --rules R --today D   (Dec 1-31 only: what's left under each kid's annual cap)
  match    --kids F --rules R --today D --seen F [--mark]   (routine: only gifts not seen before that fit a kid)
  mfi      --zip Z   (median family income from Census Reporter table B19113; network; never a made-up table)
  scan     --text T   (SSN, full birthdate, account number, card number)
  guard    --text T --rules R   (sensitive data, tax or legal advice, scam signs, politics, non-official links)
"""
import argparse, csv, datetime as dt, json, re, sys

KID_FIELDS = ["id","name","birth_year","birth_month","zip","state","status","citizen","mfi","mfi_source","updated"]
C_FIELDS = ["kid","date","who","amount","type"]
STATUSES = {"military_overseas", "military_base", "foster"}
CTYPES = {"family", "employer", "federal_seed", "donor_gift"}

SENSITIVE_OPENER = ("Please don't send Social Security numbers, account numbers or full birthdates here. I only need each "
                    "child's age or birth month and year, ZIP and state. I didn't save what you sent.")
TAX_OPENER = ("I can't give tax or legal advice. I can show you what the official IRS and Treasury pages say, with links, "
              "and a tax professional can tell you what fits your family.")
SCAM_OPENER = ("Careful: this looks like a scam sign. Real Trump account gifts don't cost anything to claim, and no one "
               "legitimate asks for a fee, gift cards or your SSN by text, email or DM. Use only the official app, "
               "trumpaccount.com, trumpaccounts.gov or irs.gov.")
POLITICS_OPENER = "I stay out of politics. I just help you check the money your kids may be eligible for."
LINK_OPENER = "That link is not one of the official sites I use, so I won't open or vouch for it. Official sites:"

TAX = [r"\btax(es|able|ed)?\b", r"\bdeduct", r"\bwrite[- ]?off\b", r"\blegal(ly)?\b", r"\blawyer|attorney\b",
       r"\bcustody\b", r"\b(better|worse) than (a )?(529|roth|ira|utma|ugma)\b", r"\bis it worth\b", r"\bshould i (invest|put|contribute)\b",
       r"\bfinancial aid\b", r"\bmedicaid|ssi|snap benefits\b"]
SCAM = [r"\b(fee|pay|payment|deposit)\b.{0,40}\b(claim|release|unlock|receive)\b", r"\b(claim|release|unlock)\b.{0,40}\b(fee|pay|payment)\b",
        r"gift ?cards?", r"\bwire\b", r"\bcrypto|bitcoin\b", r"\bverify (your|my) (ssn|social)\b", r"(text|dm|email|call)(ed)? me.{0,60}(ssn|social security|account number)",
        r"\burgent\b.{0,40}\b(gift|shares|account)\b"]
POLITICS = [r"\b(do|did) you (support|like|hate)\b", r"\b(democrat|republican|maga|liberal|conservative)s?\b", r"\bgood policy|bad policy\b",
            r"\bwho should i vote\b", r"\bpolitic(s|al)\b", r"\b(a )?good idea or\b"]

def d(s): return dt.date.fromisoformat(s.strip())

def read(path, fields):
    try:
        with open(path, newline="") as f: rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    except FileNotFoundError: rows = []
    for r in rows:
        for k in fields: r[k] = (r.get(k) or "").strip()
    return rows

def write(path, rows, fields):
    with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields, extrasaction="ignore"); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(rows)

def rules(path): return json.load(open(path))

# ---------- privacy scan ----------
MONTHS = r"(jan(uary)?|feb(ruary)?|mar(ch)?|apr(il)?|may|june?|july?|aug(ust)?|sep(t(ember)?)?|oct(ober)?|nov(ember)?|dec(ember)?)"
def scan_text(text):
    hits = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?<![\d-])(\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}|\d{3} \d{2} \d{4}|\d{9})(?![\d-])", text):
        hits.append({"kind": "ssn", "masked": "SSN-like number removed"})
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b\d{1,2}[/.-]\d{1,2}[/.-](\d{4}|\d{2})\b|\b\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\b", text):
        hits.append({"kind": "full_birthdate", "masked": "full date removed (birth month and year is enough)"})
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b" + MONTHS + r"\.? \d{1,2}(st|nd|rd|th)?,? \d{4}\b", text, re.I):
        hits.append({"kind": "full_birthdate", "masked": "full date removed (birth month and year is enough)"})
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b(?:\d[ -]?){13,19}\b", text):
        if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{3}[- ]?\d{2}[- ]?\d{4}", m.group(0).strip()):
            hits.append({"kind": "card_or_account", "masked": "long number removed"})
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b(acct|account|routing)\s*(no\.?|number|#)?\s*:?\s*\d{6,}", text, re.I):
        hits.append({"kind": "account_number", "masked": "account number removed"})
    return hits

def domain_ok(url, allow):
    u = re.sub(r"^https?://", "", url.lower()).rstrip("/.,)")
    host = u.split("/")[0]
    for a in allow:
        if "/" in a:
            if u.startswith(a.lower()) or u.startswith("www." + a.lower()): return True
        elif host == a or host.endswith("." + a): return True
    return False

def guard(text, rl):
    t = text.lower(); flags = []; opener = []
    if scan_text(text): flags.append("sensitive"); opener.append(SENSITIVE_OPENER)
    if any(re.search(p, t) for p in SCAM): flags.append("scam"); opener.append(SCAM_OPENER)
    bad = [u for u in re.findall(r"(?:https?://)?(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)+[a-z]{2,}(?:/[^\s]*)?", t)
           if re.search(r"[a-z]", u.split("/")[0]) and "." in u.split("/")[0] and not domain_ok(u, rl["official_domains"])]
    bad = [u for u in bad if not re.fullmatch(r"\d+(\.\d+)+", u)]
    if bad:
        flags.append("unofficial_link")
        opener.append(LINK_OPENER + " trumpaccounts.gov, trumpaccount.com, irs.gov, home.treasury.gov.")
    if any(re.search(p, t) for p in TAX): flags.append("tax_legal"); opener.append(TAX_OPENER)
    if any(re.search(p, t) for p in POLITICS): flags.append("politics"); opener.append(POLITICS_OPENER)
    return {"flags": flags, "unofficial_links": bad, "reply_must_start_with": " ".join(opener)}

# ---------- kids ----------
def slug(s): return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s.lower()).strip("-")[:20] or "kid"

def cmd_add(a, rl):
    for v in (a.name, a.zip or "", a.state or ""):
        if scan_text(v): sys.exit(json.dumps({"refused": "sensitive", "say": SENSITIVE_OPENER}))
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}", str(a.birth_year)): sys.exit("birth year must be YYYY (no full birthdate)")
    by = int(a.birth_year); today = d(a.today) if a.today else dt.date.today()
    if by > today.year or by < today.year - 25: sys.exit("birth year out of range")
    bm = ""
    if a.birth_month:
        if not (a.birth_month.isdigit() and 1 <= int(a.birth_month) <= 12): sys.exit("birth month must be 1-12")
        bm = str(int(a.birth_month))
    z = (a.zip or "").strip()
    if z and not re.fullmatch(r"\d{5}", z[:5]): sys.exit("ZIP must be 5 digits")
    st = [s for s in (a.status or "").split(";") if s]
    if any(s not in STATUSES for s in st): sys.exit("status must be from " + ",".join(sorted(STATUSES)))
    rows = read(a.kids, KID_FIELDS); ids = {r["id"] for r in rows}
    base = slug(a.name); kid, n = base, 2
    while kid in ids: kid, n = base + "-" + str(n), n + 1
    r = {"id": kid, "name": a.name.strip(), "birth_year": str(by), "birth_month": bm, "zip": z[:5], "state": (a.state or "").upper(),
         "status": ";".join(st), "citizen": a.citizen or "unknown", "mfi": "", "mfi_source": "", "updated": today.isoformat()}
    rows.append(r); write(a.kids, rows, KID_FIELDS)
    ask = [k for k in ("zip", "state") if not r[k]] + (["birth_month"] if not bm else [])
    print(json.dumps({"added": kid, "ask_owner_for": ask}))

def cmd_setmfi(a, rl):
    rows = read(a.kids, KID_FIELDS); hit = next((r for r in rows if r["id"] == a.id), None)
    if not hit: sys.exit("no kid with id " + a.id)
    if a.mfi not in ("none", ""): float(a.mfi)
    hit["mfi"] = a.mfi; hit["mfi_source"] = a.source; write(a.kids, rows, KID_FIELDS)
    print(json.dumps({"id": a.id, "mfi": a.mfi}))

def age_range(r, on):
    by = int(r["birth_year"]); bm = int(r["birth_month"]) if r["birth_month"] else None
    if bm is None: return (on.year - by - 1, on.year - by)
    if on.month > bm: return (on.year - by, on.year - by)
    if on.month < bm: return (on.year - by - 1, on.year - by - 1)
    return (on.year - by - 1, on.year - by)   # birthday month: could be either

def verdict(r, g, today):
    rule = g["rule"]; why = []; ok = True; unsure = []
    by = int(r["birth_year"]); st = set(s for s in r["status"].split(";") if s)
    if rule.get("turns18_after_year_of_opening"):
        if by + 18 <= today.year: ok = False; why.append("turns 18 in %d or earlier, so a new account can't be opened this year" % (by + 18))
        else: why.append("will not turn 18 before the end of %d" % today.year)
        unsure.append("needs a valid Social Security number (you don't need to tell me it)")
    if "born_from" in rule:
        lo, hi = d(rule["born_from"]).year, d(rule["born_to"]).year
        if lo <= by <= hi: why.append("born in %d (rule: %d to %d)" % (by, lo, hi))
        else: ok = False; why.append("born in %d, outside %d to %d" % (by, lo, hi))
    if rule.get("needs_us_citizen"):
        if r["citizen"] == "no": ok = False; why.append("must be a U.S. citizen")
        elif r["citizen"] != "yes": unsure.append("must be a U.S. citizen with a valid SSN")
    if "age_min" in rule:
        a0, a1 = age_range(r, today)
        if a1 < rule["age_min"] or a0 > rule["age_max"]: ok = False; why.append("age %s, outside %d to %d" % (a0 if a0 == a1 else "%d or %d" % (a0, a1), rule["age_min"], rule["age_max"]))
        elif a0 < rule["age_min"] or a1 > rule["age_max"]: unsure.append("age is right at the edge (%d or %d); the donor hasn't said what date ages are counted" % (a0, a1))
        else: why.append("age %s (rule: %d to %d)" % (a1 if a0 == a1 else "%d or %d" % (a0, a1), rule["age_min"], rule["age_max"]))
    status_hit = bool(set(rule.get("or_status", [])) & st)
    if "mfi_max" in rule and ok:
        m = r["mfi"]
        if status_hit: why.append("status: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(rule["or_status"]) & st)))
        elif m == "none":
            if rule.get("mfi_missing_ok"): why.append("ZIP %s has no median family income reported (the rule includes these)" % r["zip"])
            else: unsure.append("ZIP %s has no median family income reported; the donor's lookup decides" % r["zip"])
        elif m == "":
            unsure.append("need the median family income for ZIP %s (look it up)" % (r["zip"] or "?"))
        elif float(m) <= rule["mfi_max"]: why.append("ZIP %s median family income $%s (rule: $%s or less; %s)" % (r["zip"], format(int(float(m)), ","), format(rule["mfi_max"], ","), r["mfi_source"] or "source not recorded"))
        else: ok = False; why.append("ZIP %s median family income $%s is above $%s" % (r["zip"], format(int(float(m)), ","), format(rule["mfi_max"], ",")))
    elif "or_status" in rule and "mfi_max" not in rule and ok:
        if status_hit: why.append("status: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(rule["or_status"]) & st)))
        elif "tx_mfi_max" in rule and r["state"] == "TX": unsure.append("Texas: the county list isn't published yet")
        else: ok = False; why.append("no matching status (needs %s%s)" % (" or ".join(rule["or_status"]), " or a listed Texas county" if "tx_mfi_max" in rule else ""))
    if not ok: v = "no"
    elif g["status"] == "unconfirmed": v = "maybe (not final)"
    elif unsure: v = "check"
    else: v = "yes"
    out = {"gift": g["id"], "name": g["name"], "verdict": v, "why": why, "to_confirm": unsure, "gift_status": g["status"],
           "link": g["link"], "next_step": g["next_step"] if v != "no" else ""}
    if g.get("unconfirmed") and v != "no": out["unconfirmed"] = g["unconfirmed"]
    if g.get("foster_note") and "foster" in st: out["note"] = g["foster_note"]
    return out

def cmd_check(a, rl):
    today = d(a.today); res = []
    for r in read(a.kids, KID_FIELDS):
        if a.id and r["id"] != a.id: continue
        res.append({"kid": r["id"], "name": r["name"], "age": age_range(r, today), "age_label": (lambda a: str(a[0]) if a[0]==a[1] else "%d or %d" % a)(age_range(r, today)), "zip": r["zip"], "state": r["state"],
                    "results": [verdict(r, g, today) for g in rl["gifts"]]})
    print(json.dumps({"checked_rules": rl["checked"], "kids": res}, indent=1))

def cmd_list(a, rl):
    print(json.dumps([{k: r[k] for k in ("id","name","birth_year","birth_month","zip","state","status","mfi")} for r in read(a.kids, KID_FIELDS)], indent=1))

# ---------- reminders ----------
def cmd_birthdays(a, rl):
    today = d(a.today); end = today + dt.timedelta(days=a.days); out = []
    bounds = []
    for g in rl["gifts"]:
        r_ = g["rule"]
        if "age_min" in r_: bounds += [(r_["age_min"], "in", g), (r_["age_max"] + 1, "out", g)]
    for r in read(a.kids, KID_FIELDS):
        by = int(r["birth_year"]); bm = int(r["birth_month"]) if r["birth_month"] else None
        for age, kind, g in bounds:
            yr = by + age
            when = dt.date(yr, bm, 1) if bm else dt.date(yr, 1, 1)
            if today <= when <= end or (bm is None and yr == today.year):   # month unknown: flag the whole year
                out.append({"kid": r["id"], "name": r["name"], "turns": age, "around": when.isoformat() if bm else str(yr),
                            "gift": g["name"], "change": "ages into" if kind == "in" else "ages out of", "gift_status": g["status"], "link": g["link"]})
        gp_end = dt.date(by + 17, 12, 31)
        if today <= gp_end <= end:
            out.append({"kid": r["id"], "name": r["name"], "turns": 18, "around": str(by + 18), "gift": "growth period",
                        "change": "growth period ends Dec 31, %d (rules change the year the child turns 18)" % (by + 17),
                        "link": "https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i4547"})
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))

def cmd_contrib(a, rl):
    if a.type not in CTYPES: sys.exit("type must be one of " + ",".join(sorted(CTYPES)))
    amt = float(a.amount)
    if amt <= 0: sys.exit("amount must be positive")
    d(a.date)
    if scan_text(a.who): sys.exit(json.dumps({"refused": "sensitive", "say": SENSITIVE_OPENER}))
    rows = read(a.contrib, C_FIELDS); rows.append({"kid": a.kid, "date": a.date, "who": a.who, "amount": "%.2f" % amt, "type": a.type})
    write(a.contrib, rows, C_FIELDS); print(json.dumps({"logged": a.kid, "amount": amt, "type": a.type}))

def totals(cpath, rl, year):
    cap = rl["annual_cap"]; out = {}
    for c in read(cpath, C_FIELDS):
        if not c["date"].startswith(str(year)): continue
        k = out.setdefault(c["kid"], {"counted": 0.0, "employer": 0.0, "exempt": 0.0, "by_who": {}})
        amt = float(c["amount"])
        if c["type"] in cap["exempt"]: k["exempt"] += amt
        else:
            k["counted"] += amt
            if c["type"] == "employer": k["employer"] += amt
        k["by_who"][c["who"]] = k["by_who"].get(c["who"], 0) + amt
    for k in out.values():
        k["cap"] = cap["amount"]; k["left"] = max(0.0, cap["amount"] - k["counted"])
        k["over"] = k["counted"] > cap["amount"]; k["employer_over"] = k["employer"] > cap["employer_part_max"]
    return out

def cmd_summary(a, rl):
    print(json.dumps({"year": a.year, "source": rl["annual_cap"]["source"], "kids": totals(a.contrib, rl, a.year)}, indent=1))

def cmd_december(a, rl):
    today = d(a.today)
    if today.month != 12: print(json.dumps({"due": False})); return
    t = totals(a.contrib, rl, today.year); kids = read(a.kids, KID_FIELDS); lines = []
    for r in kids:
        k = t.get(r["id"], {"counted": 0.0, "left": rl["annual_cap"]["amount"]})
        lines.append({"kid": r["id"], "name": r["name"], "counted_so_far": k["counted"], "left_this_year": k["left"]})
    print(json.dumps({"due": True, "year": today.year, "resets": rl["annual_cap"]["resets"], "note": rl["annual_cap"]["note"],
                      "source": rl["annual_cap"]["source"], "kids": lines}, indent=1))

def cmd_match(a, rl):
    today = d(a.today)
    try: seen = set(l.strip() for l in open(a.seen) if l.strip())
    except FileNotFoundError: seen = set()
    kids = read(a.kids, KID_FIELDS); hits = []; new = []
    for g in rl["gifts"]:
        key = g["id"] + "@" + g["status"] + "@" + json.dumps(g["rule"], sort_keys=True)
        if key in seen: continue
        new.append(key)
        for r in kids:
            v = verdict(r, g, today)
            if v["verdict"] != "no": hits.append({"kid": r["id"], "name": r["name"], **v})
    if a.mark:
        with open(a.seen, "a") as f:
            for k in new: f.write(k + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"new_or_changed_rules": len(new), "matches": hits, "ping": bool(hits)}, indent=1))

def cmd_mfi(a, rl):
    """Median family income for a ZIP (Census ZCTA, table B19113) from Census Reporter, the lookup Invest America names for the Dell gift."""
    import urllib.request
    z = a.zip.strip()[:5]
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{5}", z): sys.exit("ZIP must be 5 digits")
    url = "https://api.censusreporter.org/1.0/data/show/latest?table_ids=B19113&geo_ids=86000US" + z
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "TrumpAccountCheck-grokbot-template/1.0"})
    try: data = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20))
    except Exception as e:
        if "400" in str(e):
            print(json.dumps({"zip": z, "mfi": "", "say": "ZIP %s is not a Census ZIP area (often an APO/FPO, PO box or business ZIP), so I can't confirm its median family income. The donor's notice or lookup decides." % z})); return
        print(json.dumps({"zip": z, "mfi": "", "say": "I couldn't reach Census Reporter. Check the ZIP yourself: https://censusreporter.org/tables/B19113/", "error": str(e)[:120]})); return
    geo = data.get("data", {}).get("86000US" + z)
    est = geo["B19113"]["estimate"].get("B19113001") if geo else None
    print(json.dumps({"zip": z, "mfi": "none" if est is None else est, "release": data.get("release", {}).get("name", ""),
                      "page": "https://censusreporter.org/profiles/86000US%s/" % z,
                      "caveat": "Census ZIP areas (ZCTAs) don't match mail ZIPs exactly. The donor's own lookup or notice is the final word."}))

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(); s = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    x = s.add_parser("add"); x.add_argument("--kids", required=True); x.add_argument("--name", required=True); x.add_argument("--birth-year", required=True)
    for f in ("--birth-month","--zip","--state","--status","--citizen","--today","--rules"): x.add_argument(f)
    x = s.add_parser("setmfi"); [x.add_argument(f, required=True) for f in ("--kids","--id","--mfi","--source")]; x.add_argument("--rules")
    x = s.add_parser("list"); x.add_argument("--kids", required=True); x.add_argument("--rules")
    x = s.add_parser("check"); [x.add_argument(f, required=True) for f in ("--kids","--rules","--today")]; x.add_argument("--id")
    x = s.add_parser("birthdays"); [x.add_argument(f, required=True) for f in ("--kids","--rules","--today")]; x.add_argument("--days", type=int, default=60)
    x = s.add_parser("contrib"); [x.add_argument(f, required=True) for f in ("--contrib","--kid","--amount","--who","--date","--type")]; x.add_argument("--rules")
    x = s.add_parser("summary"); [x.add_argument(f, required=True) for f in ("--contrib","--rules","--year")]
    x = s.add_parser("december"); [x.add_argument(f, required=True) for f in ("--kids","--contrib","--rules","--today")]
    x = s.add_parser("match"); [x.add_argument(f, required=True) for f in ("--kids","--rules","--today","--seen")]; x.add_argument("--mark", action="store_true")
    x = s.add_parser("mfi"); x.add_argument("--zip", required=True); x.add_argument("--rules")
    x = s.add_parser("scan"); x.add_argument("--text", required=True)
    x = s.add_parser("guard"); x.add_argument("--text", required=True); x.add_argument("--rules", required=True)
    a = p.parse_args()
    if a.cmd == "scan": h = scan_text(a.text); print(json.dumps({"found": len(h), "items": h}, indent=1)); return
    rl = rules(a.rules) if getattr(a, "rules", None) else None
    if a.cmd == "guard": print(json.dumps(guard(a.text, rl), indent=1)); return
    {"add": cmd_add, "setmfi": cmd_setmfi, "list": cmd_list, "check": cmd_check, "birthdays": cmd_birthdays, "contrib": cmd_contrib,
     "summary": cmd_summary, "mfi": cmd_mfi, "december": cmd_december, "match": cmd_match}[a.cmd](a, rl)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
